name: Central African Republic
summary_text: Central African Republic is dangerous for trans visitors. Same-sex conduct is legal, but the state barely exists outside Bangui; armed groups control most territory; mob violence and police extortion against perceived LGBT people are documented; no LGR, no community infrastructure.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no CAR-specific page); the Trust maps jurisdictions criminalising LGBT people. The Central African Republic does not criminalise same-sex conduct but has no protections.
ILGA World 'Our Identities Under Arrest' (2023) - global report on laws criminalising LGBT people; the fetched copy contained no extractable text at research time (image-based PDF).

sources.title: Central African Republic - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2023 Human Rights Report for the Central African Republic: official assessment including the SOGI section - same-sex conduct not criminalised but societal discrimination and the absence of protections in a conflict-affected state.

US State Department 2012 Human Rights Report for the Central African Republic: documents extrajudicial killings, torture, rape by security forces and Seleka rebels, harsh prison conditions - general human-rights context with limited LGBT-specific content.

sources.title: Slow or no progress in Central Africa
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes/ILGA (May 2019): overview of LGBT rights in five Central African countries (Cameroon, CAR, Chad, Gabon, DRC) by activists Julie Makuala Di Baku and Jean Paul Enama - SOGI issues remain taboo and 'contrary to African values'; Cameroon kept its criminalising provision; CAR has a legal vacuum; walking the streets as a same-sex couple is visibly difficult across the region.

UN OHCHR summary of stakeholders' submissions for the CAR's UPR (45th session, Jan 2024): covers international obligations, national human-rights framework, institutional infrastructure - includes SOGI-related stakeholder recommendations.
